title: CSVGN1
description: Parameters of static shunt compensator: CSVGN1 in PSSE It has no bus of its own: exactly one static injection device, with the same name, names it in its `dynamic_injector` property, and that device supplies the rest of its data.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the dynamic injection. Must equal the name of the static injection device that names it in `dynamic_injector`.

T1.description: Time constant in s. Units: s.

T2.description: Time constant in s. Units: s.

T3.description: Time constant in s. Units: s.

T4.description: Time constant in s. Units: s.

T5.description: Time constant in s. Units: s.

Vmax.description: Maximum voltage in pu. Units: pu.

Vmin.description: Minimum voltage in pu. Units: pu.

base_power.description: Base power for the per-unit parameters of this model. Usually equal to the `base_power` of the static injection device that names this model. Units: MVA.
